name: coverage-renames-refusal-pins-retired-verb-fqn-wording
body: The coverage renames/moves e2e (coverage_renames_moves_destination_counts) pins the verify refusal's suggestion wording verbatim — `--verb creates --fqn <fqn>` — which is the retired pre-edge-model CLI vocabulary that src/plan_cmd/verify.rs still emits (the sibling coverage_refuses_when_an_implemented_by_fqn_is_untouched asserts the same substring). Upgrade — when the verify refusal message migrates to the operation-edge vocabulary (`--{kind}-{create|modify|delete|move|rename}` / `--target`), re-key this assertion and the sibling's to the new wording.
